subject.title: feat: add Podman agent sandbox backend

question: Does the sandbox owner approve the PR’s supported Podman target contract—local engines and Podman Machine only, with arbitrary remote Podman connections rejected—and its rootless isolation semantics as a built-in backend?
rationale: The implementation changes the product’s sandbox security boundary. The existing maintainer comment settles core-versus-plugin ownership, but it does not by itself record acceptance of the final connection and isolation contract.

options.title: Approve the bounded Podman contract
options.body: Accept local Podman and Podman Machine as supported targets, retain the rejection of arbitrary remote connections, and proceed with normal merge review.

options.title: Narrow or revise the contract
options.body: Request a targeted change to the allowed connection model or rootless behavior before accepting the backend.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded Podman contract
recommendation.body: Accept local Podman and Podman Machine as supported targets, retain the rejection of arbitrary remote connections, and proceed with normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current sandbox refactor and supplied the maintainer guidance on the correct ownership boundary.
